_about: The 360 depth of a panorama (MoGe-2 ViT-L, Microsoft, MIT; ComfyUI's native MoGePanoramaInference: the panorama split into perspective views, depth per view, merged) saved as a mesh (GLB). bpy_jobs/pano_world.py --ground depth reads only the DISTANCE of each panorama pixel from it (cinestudio/pano_depth.py) and builds its own mesh in Blender's panorama convention; the scale comes from the eye height. Relative scale (no metric scale across views); the sky (no geometry) is set far away by the node.
